right-handed neutrinos N_nR as annihilation final states
excited_or_degenerate_states: _2R can coannihilate with _1R if the mass splitting is below about 20 percent
unstable_parent_particles: right-handed neutrinos N_nR decay to Higgs and lepton doublets after DM annihilation

dark_sector_couplings: Yukawa interactions generating the three-loop Majorana mass submatrix
interaction_operators: Y_N N_R _1^* _R^C
y l_L eta_R
M n_R N_R^C
interactions.cp_structure: pseudo-Dirac neutrino splitting enters leptogenesis; detailed DM CP structure not specified
interactions.flavor_structure: Yukawa matrices are constrained by inverse-seesaw neutrino masses and charged-lepton flavor structure

theory.notes: The paper writes the Yukawa sector and scalar potential for Model 1 with global U(1) prime times Z2 symmetry and residual Z4 times Z2 after symmetry breaking.

symmetries.stabilizing_mechanism: The residual Z2 symmetry protects the lightest odd dark-sector state and makes the _1R fermion stable in the studied hierarchy.

symmetries.name: U(1)'
symmetries.breaking: spontaneously broken at the TeV scale to residual Z4

symmetries.name: accidental U(1)_L
symmetries.breaking: softly broken by a neutral-lepton mass term

mechanisms: thermal WIMP freeze-out
annihilation to right-handed neutrinos via t-channel scalar exchange
production.notes: The paper computes the Yukawa coupling needed for _1R to fit the entire observed relic abundance in a standard radiation-dominated freeze-out setup.

phase_space.notes: The paper uses a nonrelativistic equilibrium density in the Boltzmann freeze-out equation.

validity_domain.condition: The detailed relic-density analysis focuses on the hierarchy where _1R is the lightest stable odd state.
caveats: Scalar dark matter candidates are mentioned but not analyzed in the same detail.

validity_domain.condition: The freeze-out calculation assumes the total energy density is dominated by Standard Model radiation.
The scan assumes a mass splitting large enough that _1R-_2R coannihilation can be ignored.

global.description: The residual Z2 symmetry is preserved, and _1R is the lightest odd state in the studied hierarchy.
The dark matter abundance is computed in a standard radiation-dominated cosmological history.
The _1R and _2R mass splitting is taken larger than the regime where coannihilation is important.

dominant_uncertainties: scalar dark matter variants not analyzed in detail
robustness.notes: The paper gives explicit model-building, annihilation, and relic-density calculations for the fermionic hierarchy.

warnings.warning: This card represents the detailed fermionic _1R hierarchy, not the scalar DM alternatives mentioned in the paper.
warnings.mitigation: Do not use this row as a scalar-DM model card without separate extraction.

warnings.warning: The paper notes _1R can coannihilate with _2R when the splitting is small, but the analysis assumes a larger splitting.
warnings.mitigation: Include coupled Boltzmann equations before applying the card to near-degenerate spectra.

primary_papers.title: Three-Loop Inverse Scotogenic Seesaw Models
primary_papers.notes: Assigned SQLite full text was the only source used.

source_chunks_or_sections.quote_or_summary: Model 1 extends the SM with singlet scalars, neutral leptons, U(1) prime, Z2, and residual Z4.
The residual Z2 protects the lightest odd state; the paper focuses on fermionic _1R dark matter.
_1R annihilates to right-handed neutrinos through t-channel _1 exchange and is fitted to the full relic abundance.

unresolved_items: Text extraction strips the original Greek symbols, so symbol names are recorded in plain ASCII as they appear in the assigned text.
